about.title: Mathematician by training, builder by habit.
about.body: I studied mathematics and statistics in London, spent a year teaching frontier models what good answers look like, and now design and ship AI products for a sportswear group and my own startup. I care about systems that explain themselves, and the unglamorous integration work that makes them run in production.
